name: First Spark
description: A four-on-the-floor house groove on a TR-909: the shortest possible patch.

name: Acid Breakfast
description: A squelchy 303-style line: MELODY into a saw VOICE, a resonant FILTER swept by an LFO, echoes from EMBERS FX, all over a 909 kick.

name: Vandal Breaks
description: The Amen break looped by the SAMPLER, then chopped, thinned and stuttered by the VANDALIZER, with a random LFO deciding how much gets lost — over a quiet supersaw pad.

name: Glass Garden
description: Slow ambient: one MELODY feeds two VOICES (a kalimba and a warm pad an octave down), drowned in reverb and echo while an LFO drifts the kalimba across the stereo field.

name: Polymeter Pastry
description: Layers of different lengths — 16, 12, 13 and 7 steps — that drift apart and re-align, like the layers of the dessert this app is named after.

name: Industrial Furnace
description: A 909 kick and a crushed, driven snare under a bit-crushed cello stabbing out a Euclidean 5-in-8 rhythm through the furnace.
